Student life
KTH Royal Institute of Technology
KTH is Sweden's largest and most respected technical university—ranked top 100 in the 2022 QS World University Rankings. By choosing KTH, you gain access to a vibrant student life and a prestigious academic environment.
As one of our 1,500 doctoral students, you will take courses and devote yourself to a research project under the supervision of an experienced researcher. Most students are employed and receive a monthly salary. Begin your journey towards a KTH degree today.
PhD student Agnes explores how ethical AI use of media can strengthen society and democracy
Agnes Stenbom, an industrial doctoral student at KTH, works to ensure that ethical AI use of media can strengthen society and democracy.“The goal is to support the responsible use of AI in journalism,” she says.
Read an article on Agnes research
PhD student Monika researches heat pumps that can radically cut emissions
Monika Ignatowicz is a PhD student at KTH's Department of Energy Technology where she researches high temperature heat pumps. ""The technology, which is relatively new, is constantly improving and has enormous potential in terms of energy efficiency", says Monika.
Read an article on Monikas research
Research at the forefront
Research at KTH generates new knowledge and technological development that can lead to significant change – for the world, for society and for people. Our scientific advances are based on the academic freedom to explore the unknown, while at the same time finding solutions that will benefit society.
